name: Process profile: SAGA.ta_morphometry.0
abstract: Process profile of the live OGC API - Processes process `SAGA.ta_morphometry.0` (ZOO-Project, Geonovum testbed), with a process-type entry linking to its Implementation Profile. Static processDescription only, no execute/results/provenance.
description:
Process profile of the live OGC API - Processes process `SAGA.ta_morphometry.0` (ZOO-Project, Geonovum testbed): <https://host1.tb.geonovum.geolabs.fr/ogc-api/processes/SAGA.ta_morphometry.0>.

> Calculates the local morphometric terrain parameters slope, aspect and if supported by the chosen method also the curvature. Besides tangential curvature also its horizontal and vertical components (i.e. plan and profile curvature) can be calculated.

(the process's own description, as served)

## The tool behind it

[SAGA ta_morphometry 0 (Slope, Aspect, Curvature)](https://saga-gis.sourceforge.io/saga_tool_doc/7.3.0/ta_morphometry_0.html) -- SAGA 7.3.0 tool library documentation, the version deployed on the testbed (not yet exposed by its processDescription).

Tool 0 of SAGA's Terrain Analysis - Morphometry library (author O. Conrad, 2001; command line `saga_cmd ta_morphometry 0`). It computes the local morphometric parameters of an elevation grid -- slope, aspect and, depending on the chosen method, curvatures (general, profile, plan, tangential, ...) -- from a local fit of the surface; the default method is the 9 parameter 2nd order polynom of Zevenbergen & Thorne (1987).

On this deployment:

- One process, many outputs: only `SLOPE` is bound to the Implementation Profile (`slope`); `ASPECT` and the ten curvature grids are supplementary outputs of the live service (Table 21 footnote b).

## Implementation Profile

Implements [`Slope`](https://geolabs.github.io/bblocks-generic-profiles/def/implementation-profile/slope) (`generic-profiles.implementation-profile.slope`, bblocks-generic-profiles).

Deployed inputs/outputs and the Implementation Profile's (`bindings` in `scripts/profiles.yaml`), with the data type each bound input/output inherits (`processDescription.inherited.json`):

| Deployed | Implementation Profile | Data type |
|---|---|---|
| `ELEVATION` | input `elevation` | `elevation-model` |
| `METHOD`, `UNIT_SLOPE`, `UNIT_ASPECT` | -- (the deployment's own inputs, Table 21 footnote b) | -- |
| `SLOPE` | output `result` | `raster-single-band` |
| `ASPECT`, `C_GENE`, `C_PROF`, `C_PLAN`, `C_TANG`, `C_LONG`, `C_CROS`, `C_MINI`, `C_MAXI`, `C_TOTA`, `C_ROTO` | -- (the deployment's own outputs, Table 21 footnote b) | -- |

## Examples

- `processDescription.json`: the processDescription as served, ZOO-Project-internal fields removed.
- `processDescription.inherited.json`: the same with what OGC 14-065r1 Table 21 has it inherit at the Implementation (instance level): keywords and metadata references to its profiles, and the data type of each bound input/output.
- `process-type.json`: its candidate process-type entry.

examples.title: processDescription
examples.content: Live OGC API - Processes processDescription, normalised (ZOO-Project-internal fields dropped).

examples.title: processDescription with its inheritance (Implementation, instance level)
examples.content: The same processDescription as OGC 14-065r1 Table 21 wants it at the Implementation (instance level) of `https://geolabs.github.io/bblocks-generic-profiles/def/implementation-profile/slope`: the Implementation Profile's keywords (E) on the process and on each bound input/output, and, per footnote a, its list of metadata references to superior profiles extended with a Table 22 `implementation` reference to the Implementation Profile -- on the process only. Each bound input/output keeps its Implementation Profile counterpart's reference to the Generic Profile input/output (`generic-input`/`-output`) and adds one to that counterpart itself (`<Implementation Profile>/inputs/<name>`, `/outputs/<name>`, `implementation-input`/`-output`): roles defined by bblocks-generic-profiles, since Table 22 only names whole profiles. Each bound input/output also carries the `dataType` of that counterpart, a concept of bblocks-data-types. Which deployed input/output is which Implementation Profile one is `bindings` in scripts/profiles.yaml; inputs/outputs bound to none are the deployment's own additions (footnote b). Not what the deployment serves today (docs/OPEN-QUESTIONS.md Q-TABLE21-INSTANCE).
